name: Ocean Cadillac
climate: Hot, humid South Florida: strong sun, heat, heavy rain, hurricane season and flood risk. No snow, road salt or winter driving.
brandNaming: Write the electric model names in capitals, as cadillac.com does: LYRIQ, LYRIQ-V, OPTIQ, OPTIQ-V, VISTIQ, CELESTIQ (never "Lyriq" or "Optiq")
Escalade IQ and Escalade IQL: always capitalize "IQ" / "IQL" (cadillac.com: "2026 Escalade IQ", "ESCALADE IQL")
V-Series models take a hyphen: CT4-V, CT5-V, Escalade-V, LYRIQ-V, OPTIQ-V; "Blackwing" only for the CT4-V and CT5-V Blackwing
XT4 (last model year 2025, inventory search only on cadillac.com) and XT6 (not listed on cadillac.com) are no longer sold new: never present them as current new models

Name ACDelco products (ACDelco, ACDelco Gold, ACDelco GM OE dexos 1) only where the dealer offer source states them; never write "GM Genuine Parts", "Cadillac Certified Service" or "Cadillac Premium Care" (dealer rule)
Call the pickup service "Premium Pickup & Delivery", as the live site does
Service is closed on Sunday: never say service is open 7 days a week
Do not mention Mobile Service+ or loaner/courtesy vehicles until the dealer confirms them (on hold in the project files, although live pages exist)

ddc.socialTags: DDC writes og:title (= the full <title>), og:type "website" and og:url (the requested URL) on every page, plus a canonical link. Content pages built with the Custom HTML component (/wbp-*.htm, /promotions/service/*.htm) carry no og:image, no og:description and no meta description live. Pages whose MetaData Description is filled emit one combined <meta name="description" property="og:description">; the native blog post also gets og:image from its featured image. No twitter: tags on any page.

maintainerNotes: Phones: About Us (US location) shows Contact/Sales (786) 708-8302, Service (786) 708-8318 and Parts (786) 321-3090. The site-wide JSON-LD lists (786) 321-3090 (the Parts number) as the main telephone, the Contact and Hours & Directions body copy says to call (786) 220-2297, and the Google listing number (786) 699-8626 was not seen on the site. No mainPhone is set; confirm the main line before showing one.
No general test-drive page exists; only /ev-test-drive-cadillac.htm (EVs only: ESCALADE IQ, VISTIQ, LYRIQ, OPTIQ). It is not set as a route; use it only in EV articles.

Service hub: /service/index.htm (linked as "Service Center" on About Us) redirects to /schedule_service.htm, so routes.serviceHub uses /service/service-center.htm. Confirm the page the dealer wants as the service hub.

Article URL: the two live Ocean articles are content pages at /wbp-<slug>.htm; the native DDC blog uses /blog/YYYY/month/D/<slug>.htm; the 08/18 decision prefers root /<slug>.htm without "wbp-". Confirm before the first new article.

Meta descriptions are missing live on all four pasted pages checked (/promotions/service/index.htm, /promotions/service/oil-filter-change-package.htm and both /wbp- articles). Confirm the MetaData Editor Description actually saves.

Title: DDC appends " | Ocean Cadillac" to child-page titles. The oil-package page name itself ends in "| Ocean Cadillac", so its H1 shows the dealer name and its title shows it twice. Enter the page name and Title without the dealer name.

Mobile Service+ and loaners are on hold in the project files, but the live site has /cadillac-mobile-service-plus.htm and /courtesy-transportation-vehicle.htm, and the Premium Pickup & Delivery page offers courtesy vehicles. Confirm before mentioning either.

Group: About Us says Ocean Cadillac has been a member of the Murgado Automotive Group since 2014, and the building carries the group sign; the 08/2026 articles still hold the group name pending sign-off. Confirm it may be named in article copy.
The Media Library has no confirmed current-design (model year 2025 or later) gas Escalade or Escalade ESV photo; request one for gas Escalade articles.
The logo is a JPEG on white (no transparent or white version found); place it on a white area only.

Decided 10/12: article URL follows the live pattern /wbp-<slug>.htm; links ink #111 with underline (project decision), square corners; fonts = theme faces (Cadillac Gothic / Gothic Narrow) per the "theme fonts" default; the group is named (About Us states membership since 2014).
Dealer.com shows the MetaData Title unchanged; only an empty field falls back to the page name + the dealer name (checked live on Brickell CDJR pages, 2026-10-12).
